Actually the rule says "take one side and mirror it to the other side". So the output replaces the non-line side with mirror of the opposite side across the line. The line itself may or may not be symmetric but stays. For vertical/horizontal, the line is a full row/column uniform; for diagonal, line is full diagonal uniform. Then mirror across line.
